attributes.action: England's independent vote....Scotland have had theirs, time we had ours
attributes.additional_details: I am a floating voter, the right and left are out of touch on many things, this will hopefully wake them up if we can get it across the line
attributes.background: Parliament is out, we have a new prime minister,Scotland wants independence,some of Wales want the same, numbers are growing, let's give them what they want, and become independent without them depending on us,we have all grown apart, time to ask the English what they really want
